brief.text: Thesis is WATCH (live 2026-09-21), downgraded from strengthening (08-31) to watch on 09-14; ladder rank 3 in Compute/Hyperscaler (moved from 2 on 09-15). WATCH rests on 1m peer underperformance, -7.2pp vs XLK (-1.44 sigma) on 09-21, narrowed from -7.81pp on 09-19, offset by partnership tailwinds (Qualcomm, OpenAI ad deal). Mean target $328.17 is about 29% above the $254.15 close (n=40, 09-18). Position was added (+2sh 09-18) into WATCH, now 5sh / 3.66% of equity (09-21). All observations are secondary. KEY: Peer gap -7.2pp vs XLK 09-21, from -7.81pp 09-19; no catch-up (day move 0.15x ATR); Correction: the 09-14 gap of -3.30pp was superseded; the 09-19 figure is -7.81pp (-1.55 sigma); Equity weight now 3.66% (09-21), replacing 3.77% (09-19/20); Buy added while thesis is WATCH and the gap widened: flagged as sizing ahead of thesis resolution (09-18); Quality flag 08-30: capex $44.2B exceeded OCF $26.03B; FCF -$18.17B; LT debt +81.4% YoY to $119.07B. OPEN: Will Q3 show AWS growth accelerating faster than capex, or capex held flat? (bench entry condition, 09-08); Does AWS reach >=40% growth in Q3, which the 09-15 rank note says would close the gap to GOOG?; Does the peer laggard status persist or catch up?.
